import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.interpolate import interp1d

# Load data from attached file
file_id = '2026-07-29/T044.csv'
data = files[0] if len(files) > 0 else None # Should be handled by passing file_ids
# Actually, since I passed file_ids, they are in `files` list
# Let me use the variable name as per instructions: files[i]["table"]["column"]

spec_data = files[0]
x = spec_data["table"]["raman_shift_cm-1"]
y = spec_data["table"]["intensity"]

# Crop to 980-1020 cm-1
mask = (x >= 980) & (x <= 1020)
x_crop = x[mask]
y_crop = y[mask]

# Baseline subtraction: use the minimum in the crop as a simple baseline
baseline = np.min(y_crop)
y_sub = y_crop - baseline

# Find peak
idx_max = np.argmax(y_sub)
x_peak = x_crop[idx_max]
y_max = y_sub[idx_max]

half_max = y_max / 2

# Linear interpolation to find exact half-maximum crossings
# Left side
left_side = y_sub[:idx_max+1]
x_left = x_crop[:idx_max+1]
# Find index where it first crosses half_max (from left)
idx_l = np.where(left_side >= half_max)[0][0]
if idx_l > 0:
    f_l = interp1d([x_left[idx_l-1], x_left[idx_l]], [left_side[idx_l-1], left_side[idx_l]])
    x_half_l = f_l(half_max)
else:
    x_half_l = x_left[0]

# Right side
right_side = y_sub[idx_max:]
x_right = x_crop[idx_max:]
# Find index where it first drops below half_max (from peak)
idx_r = np.where(right_side < half_max)[0][0]
if idx_r < len(right_side)-1:
    f_r = interp1d([x_right[idx_r], x_right[idx_r+1]], [right_side[idx_r], right_side[idx_r+1]])
    x_half_r = f_r(half_max)
else:
    x_half_r = x_right[-1]

fwhm = x_half_r - x_half_l

print(f"Peak position: {x_peak:.2f} cm-1")
print(f"Max intensity (above baseline): {y_max:.2f}")
print(f"Half max height: {half_max:.2f}")
print(f"Left half-max crossing: {x_half_l:.4f}")
print(f"Right half-max crossing: {x_half_r:.4f}")
print(f"FWHM: {fwhm:.4f} cm-1")

plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
plt.plot(x_crop, y_crop, 'b-', label='Spectrum')
plt.axhline(baseline + half_max, color='r', linestyle='--', label='Half Max')
plt.axvline(x_half_l, color='g', linestyle=':', label=f'Left: {x_half_l:.2f}')
plt.axvline(x_half_r, color='g', linestyle=':', label=f'Right: {x_half_r:.2f}')
plt.title(f"FWHM Calculation for Peak near 1000 cm-1 (T044.csv)\nFWHM = {fwhm:.4f} cm-1")
plt.xlabel("Raman Shift (cm-1)")
plt.ylabel("Intensity")
plt.legend()
plt.grid(True)
plt.show()

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load data from attached file
spec_data = files[0]
x = spec_data["table"]["raman_shift_cm-1"]
y = spec_data["table"]["intensity"]

# Crop to 980-1020 cm-1
mask = (x >= 980) & (x <= 1020)
x_crop = x[mask]
y_crop = y[mask]

# Find peak and baseline
idx_max = np.argmax(y_crop)
y_max = y_crop[idx_max]
x_peak = x_crop[idx_max]

# Use the average of the ends of the interval as a simple baseline for FWHM
baseline = (y_crop[0] + y_crop[-1]) / 2
y_sub = y_crop - baseline
y_max_sub = y_sub[idx_max]
half_max_sub = y_max_sub / 2

# Find left crossing: x where y_sub(x) == half_max_sub
# Search from the left end up to the peak
idx_l = np.where(y_sub >= half_max_sub)[0][0]
if idx_l > 0:
    # Linear interpolation between (x[idx_l-1], y_sub[idx_l-1]) and (x[idx_l], y_sub[idx_l])
    x1, x2 = x_crop[idx_l-1], x_crop[idx_l]
    y1, y2 = y_sub[idx_l-1], y_sub[idx_l]
    x_half_l = x1 + (half_max_sub - y1) * (x2 - x1) / (y2 - y1)
else:
    x_half_l = x_crop[0]

# Find right crossing: x where y_sub(x) == half_max_sub
# Search from the peak to the right end
idx_r_search = np.where(y_sub[idx_max:] < half_max_sub)[0][0] + idx_max
if idx_r_search < len(y_sub) - 1:
    # Linear interpolation between (x[idx_r_search], y_sub[idx_r_search]) and (x[idx_r_search+1], y_sub[idx_r_search+1])
    # Wait, idx_r_search is the first point BELOW half_max. So we interpolate between it and the one before.
    x1, x2 = x_crop[idx_r_search-1], x_crop[idx_r_search]
    y1, y2 = y_sub[idx_r_search-1], y_sub[idx_r_search]
    x_half_r = x1 + (half_max_sub - y1) * (x2 - x1) / (y2 - y1)
else:
    x_half_r = x_crop[-1]

fwhm = x_half_r - x_half_l

print(f"Peak Position: {x_peak:.2f} cm-1")
print(f"Baseline: {baseline:.2f}")
print(f"Max Intensity (Absolute): {y_max:.2f}")
print(f"Half Max Height (Relative to baseline): {half_max_sub:.2f}")
print(f"Left half-max x: {x_half_l:.4f} cm-1")
print(f"Right half-max x: {x_half_r:.4f} cm-1")
print(f"FWHM: {fwhm:.4f} cm-1")

plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
plt.plot(x_crop, y_crop, 'b-', label='Spectrum')
plt.axhline(baseline + half_max_sub, color='r', linestyle='--', label='Half Max Level')
plt.axvline(x_half_l, color='g', linestyle=':', label=f'Left: {x_half_l:.2f}')
plt.axvline(x_half_r, color='g', linestyle=':', label=f'Right: {x_half_r:.2f}')
plt.title(f"FWHM Calculation for Peak near 1000 cm-1 (T044.csv)\nFWHM = {fwhm:.4f} cm-1")
plt.xlabel("Raman Shift (cm-1)")
plt.ylabel("Intensity")
plt.legend()
plt.grid(True)
plt.show()
